readings.title: My School Day
readings.text: My name is Aysel, and I am eleven years old. I go to a small school near my home. Every morning I get up at seven o’clock. I have eggs and bread for breakfast. My mother walks to school with me because she works in a shop near the school. My first lesson starts at eight thirty. I like English and art very much. At lunchtime, I sit with my best friend Leyla. We eat sandwiches and talk about our classes. After school, we sometimes play in the park. On Tuesdays, I go to the school library and read books about animals. I usually arrive home at four o’clock. I finish my homework before dinner. In the evening I help my little brother and then go to bed at nine thirty.

q.q: What does Aysel like at school?
q.explanation: Mətndə İngilis dili və rəsm fənnini sevdiyini bildirir.

q.q: Where does Aysel go on Tuesdays?
q.explanation: On Tuesdays, I go to the school library.

q.q: When does her first lesson start?
q.explanation: İlk dərs saat 8:30-da başlayır.

q.q: Mark each statement True or False.
statements: Her mother works at the school.
She goes to bed at nine thirty.
q.explanation: Mətnə əsasən anası məktəbdə deyil, yaxınlıqdakı mağazada işləyir.

readings.title: A Birthday Party
readings.text: My friend Murad has a birthday in June. This year he is twelve. On Saturday, his family has a small party at home. He invites six friends from his class. I arrive at three o’clock with a blue birthday card. Murad loves football, so I give him a new football book. His mother makes a chocolate cake, and his father prepares orange juice and sandwiches. We listen to music and play two games in the garden. At four thirty, we sing Happy Birthday and eat cake. Murad opens his presents and smiles a lot. He gets a blue T-shirt, some books and a toy car for his little brother. The weather is warm, and we take photos outside. I go home at six o’clock. It is a happy day for everyone.

q.q: How old is Murad this year?
q.explanation: Mətndə Muradın bu il 12 yaşı olduğu qeyd edilir.

q.q: What gift does the narrator give Murad?
q.explanation: Danışan ona futbol haqqında kitab verir.

q.q: At what time do they eat the birthday cake?
q.explanation: Saat 4:30-da tort yeyirlər.

q.q: Mark each statement True or False.
statements: The party is at a restaurant.
q.explanation: Məclis evdədir və hava istidir.

readings.title: A Day at the Zoo
readings.text: On Sunday, my family goes to the zoo. We leave our house at ten in the morning. My sister Nina takes her camera because she likes taking photos. At the zoo, we see tall giraffes, funny monkeys and three elephants. My favourite animals are the penguins. They swim in a small pool and move very quickly in the water. We have lunch at a café near the lion area. I eat a cheese sandwich, and Nina has a chicken salad. After lunch, we watch the birds. A zookeeper tells us about their food. He says some birds eat fruit and some eat fish. My father buys us small postcards at the shop. We get home before five o’clock. I am tired but very happy. I want to visit the zoo again next month.

q.q: What does Nina take to the zoo?
q.explanation: Nina şəkil çəkməyi sevdiyi üçün fotoaparat götürür.

q.q: Which animals are the narrator’s favourite?
q.explanation: Danışanın ən çox sevdiyi heyvanlar pinqvinlərdir.

q.q: What does the narrator eat for lunch?
q.explanation: Danışan pendirli sendviç yeyir.

q.q: Mark each statement True or False.
statements: They visit the zoo on Sunday.
q.explanation: Üç fil görürlər və saat beşdən əvvəl evə çatırlar.

readings.title: My Weekend
readings.text: I live with my parents and my brother in a quiet town. On Saturdays, I do not go to school. I usually clean my room in the morning and then help my dad in the garden. He grows tomatoes and small flowers. At midday, we have lunch together. After lunch, I ride my bike with my friend Ali. There is a park near our houses. We often meet other children there and play football. On Sunday morning, I visit my grandmother. She lives about twenty minutes from our home. We make biscuits and drink tea. My grandmother tells funny stories about her childhood. In the afternoon, I do my homework and prepare my school bag. I go to bed early because Monday is a school day. I enjoy my weekends very much.

q.q: What does the narrator do on Saturday morning?
options: Cleans the room and helps Dad
q.explanation: Şənbə səhər otağını yığışdırır və atasına kömək edir.

q.q: What does Dad grow?
q.explanation: Atası pomidor və çiçəklər yetişdirir.

q.q: Who does the narrator visit on Sunday?
q.explanation: Bazar günü nənəsinə gedir.

q.q: Mark each statement True or False.
statements: The narrator goes to school on Saturday.
The park is near the houses.
The narrator prepares the school bag on Friday.
q.explanation: Şənbə məktəb yoxdur, çanta bazar günü hazırlanır.

listenings.title: A Family Weekend
listenings.transcript: Hello! My name is Tom, and I am eleven years old. I live in a small town with my family. I have one sister. Her name is Anna and she is eight. On Saturday mornings, my father makes breakfast. We usually eat eggs and toast. My mother drinks tea, but I like orange juice. After breakfast, we walk to the park near our home. Anna takes her red ball, and I take my bicycle. In the afternoon, we visit my grandmother. She has a friendly brown dog called Max. We play with Max in the garden. On Sunday, we stay at home, read books and prepare for school. I love spending time with my family.

q.q: How old is Anna?
q.explanation: Anna səkkiz yaşındadır.

q.q: What does Tom like to drink?
q.explanation: Tom portağal şirəsini sevir.

q.q: Where do they go after breakfast?
q.explanation: Səhər yeməyindən sonra parka gedirlər.

q.q: Mark each statement True or False.
statements: They go to school on Sunday.
q.explanation: Top qırmızıdır və bazar günü evdə qalırlar.
